description: Out-and-return (boomerang / spectral-throw) projectile path where the RETURN is a player-driven SECOND ACTION, not an auto-return arc. Hades2 Medea Skull (Revaal): 'The Skull throws shells that explode on hit, and the special is a lunge that retrieves them.' The thrown shells travel out and explode on hit (mapped multi_projectile); the RETRIEVE is a lunge (special) the player performs to collect the spent shells -- distinct from an auto-returning boomerang because the return is an input, not an automatic path. ACCRUAL to the existing out-and-return (boomerang) qualitative mint class (already in mint_ledger, forced by a poe1 spectral-throw kit) -- but with a NEW wrinkle: the return leg is a discrete retrieval ACTION coupled to reload (see docket-candidates-batch-04, throw-retrieve finite-payload). Filed WITHOUT number per the steward-owned-counts law (FLAG 14 + §D throw-retrieve row: 'file accrual to the out-and-return family WITHOUT number; steward counts'). Kit graded APPROX un-minted (multi_projectile + pursuit/note approximates the throw; the retrieve-action return is the accrued fidelity gap).
ladder_step_audit: step1 map: no out-and-return geometry AND no retrieve-as-return primitive -- mapped thrown shells to multi_projectile. step2 approximate+note: multi_projectile + out-and-return note, graded APPROX (the throw-out is playable; the physical-retrieve return is lost). step3/4 mint: NOT minted by this batch -- filed as a qualitative ACCRUAL (WITHOUT number) to the existing out-and-return mint class; steward counts and decides whether the retrieve-action variant warrants its own mint at threshold. Kit graded un-minted APPROX->MAPPED_DOCKET.

description: Placed-proxy COUNT extension: simultaneous placed autonomous proxies (turrets/traps) stacking to a high concurrent cap. TQ2 Forge Turrets: Sentries (autonomous turrets) + Spinning Blade Traps 'stacking up to 8 traps at once' for large-zone coverage ('turrets do 130K crits each shot'). The player lays MORE devices for MORE coverage, up to an 8-device concurrent cap -- the density (8 placed proxies live) IS the build. The engine totem geometry (mapped) has a default placed-proxy count below this; the 8-count concurrent cap accrues to the existing placed-proxy-count quantitative mint class (already in mint_ledger: 'Simultaneous placed-proxy (totem) count extension to 6 with per-proxy cast-rate penalty ~0.6x and ~8s lifetime', forced by an Ancestral-totem-class poe1 kit). TQ2 Forge pushes the cap to 8 (traps) -- an accrual/extension to that same family. Filed WITHOUT number per steward-owned-counts law (FLAG 9 + FLAG 14 + §E row: 'count-8 -> accrual to the placed-proxy-count family WITHOUT number'). Kit graded CLOSE un-minted (totem + PROXY_ASCENSION/SOVEREIGNTY + count accumulator approximates the screen; the exact 8-count cap is the accrual).
ladder_step_audit: step1 map: totem geometry maps the placed autonomous proxies (poe1 ea-ballista/golementalist precedent), but the 8-concurrent-count cap exceeds the engine default. step2 approximate+note: placed-proxy count economy (accumulator) + note, graded CLOSE (playable proxy screen; exact 8-count density approximated). step3/4 mint: NOT minted by this batch -- filed as a quantitative ACCRUAL (WITHOUT number) to the existing placed-proxy-count mint class; steward counts placed-proxy-count instances across basin-1+ and decides the cap extension at threshold. Kit graded un-minted CLOSE.
